objective: Measure how much daily MLB opportunity volume can be recovered by portfolio unions of already-frozen Premium A and F5 research routes before inventing new markets or relaxing any threshold.

routes.HRPA_OR_AT2: F5_CONSENSUS AND NOT PREMIUM_A AND PITCHMIX_ELIGIBLE AND (HRPA_ADV_POS OR POSITIVE_COUNT_GTE_2)
routes.PARETO_UNION: F5_CONSENSUS AND NOT PREMIUM_A AND PITCHMIX_ELIGIBLE AND (HRPA_ADV_POS OR TBPA_ADV_POS OR POSITIVE_COUNT_GTE_2)

predeclaredPortfolios.PREMIUM_A_FG_ONLY: One FULL_GAME_HOME_ML opportunity for each frozen Premium A game.
predeclaredPortfolios.F5_CONSENSUS_ALL: One FIRST_5_HOME_ML opportunity for each frozen F5 Consensus game.
predeclaredPortfolios.PREMIUM_A_ROUTE_SWITCH: For Premium A games, use FIRST_5_HOME_ML when F5 Consensus also matches; otherwise FULL_GAME_HOME_ML. At most one opportunity per game.
predeclaredPortfolios.PREMIUM_A_PLUS_OUTSIDE_HRPA_OR_AT2: Premium A FULL_GAME_HOME_ML plus non-Premium-A F5 HRPA_OR_AT2. At most one opportunity per game.
predeclaredPortfolios.PREMIUM_A_PLUS_OUTSIDE_PARETO: Premium A FULL_GAME_HOME_ML plus non-Premium-A F5 PARETO_UNION. At most one opportunity per game.
predeclaredPortfolios.ROUTE_SWITCH_PLUS_OUTSIDE_HRPA_OR_AT2: Premium A route switch plus non-Premium-A F5 HRPA_OR_AT2. At most one opportunity per game.
predeclaredPortfolios.ROUTE_SWITCH_PLUS_OUTSIDE_PARETO: Premium A route switch plus non-Premium-A F5 PARETO_UNION. At most one opportunity per game.
predeclaredPortfolios.MULTI_MARKET_HRPA_OR_AT2: Premium A FULL_GAME_HOME_ML, plus FIRST_5_HOME_ML on Premium-A/F5 intersections, plus non-Premium-A F5 HRPA_OR_AT2. Allows two correlated markets on the same game and reports that correlation explicitly.
predeclaredPortfolios.MULTI_MARKET_PARETO: Premium A FULL_GAME_HOME_ML, plus FIRST_5_HOME_ML on Premium-A/F5 intersections, plus non-Premium-A F5 PARETO_UNION. Allows two correlated markets on the same game and reports that correlation explicitly.
predeclaredPortfolios.MAX_EXISTING_ROUTE_UNION: Premium A FULL_GAME_HOME_ML plus every F5 Consensus FIRST_5_HOME_ML. Descriptive upper bound from existing frozen route families; allows same-game correlation and does not imply promotion.

reporting.denominator: All evaluation dates with at least one t5PregameValid canonical game-anatomy row.
